parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
